The lower bound of the 90% confidence interval for the difference in survival rates (treatment minus control) is about -0.027.

The survival counts are:

| Group | Survived | Total | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Treatment | 14 | 40 | 0.35 |
| Control | 11 | 50 | 0.22 |

- **Difference:** 0.35 − 0.22 = 0.13.
- **Standard error:** √(0.35·0.65/40 + 0.22·0.78/50) ≈ 0.0955.
- **Lower bound:** 0.13 − 1.645 × 0.0955 ≈ −0.027, using the normal approximation with z = 1.645.

ANSWER: -0.027
